scenario.title: Ship a breaking change
scenario.objective: Decide whether a compatibility-breaking release is justified, reversible, and ready to ship.
successCriteria: Affected users and interfaces are named
Security and rollback risks are explicit
A human owner makes the release decision
Evidence and rollback conditions are recorded

agents.name: Kael
agents.responsibility: Turns owner intent and human impact into decision constraints.

agents.name: Vega
agents.responsibility: Checks stop conditions, reversibility, and safe release gates.

agents.name: Grok
agents.responsibility: Connects evidence, anomalies, and likely failure modes.

agents.name: Manus
agents.responsibility: Turns an approved plan into bounded, reversible actions.

agents.name: Kavach
agents.responsibility: Traces trust boundaries and rejects unsafe execution paths.

agents.name: Gemini
agents.responsibility: Collects external context and labels the quality of evidence.

agents.name: SanghaCore
agents.responsibility: Reconciles specialist outputs into one accountable decision.

agents.name: Blackbox
agents.responsibility: Records the decision, evidence, gates, and observed outcome.

trace.title: Collect the change surface
trace.action: Inventory affected interfaces, downstream users, compatibility promises, and current alternatives.

trace.title: Find coupling and failure patterns
trace.action: Relate the proposed change to known breakpoints, migration cost, and likely regressions.

trace.title: Trace the attack and rollback surface
trace.action: Check whether the change widens permissions, weakens validation, or creates an irreversible migration.

trace.title: Test the decision invariant
trace.action: Balance user impact, owner intent, and the smallest change that can achieve the product outcome.

trace.title: Compose a release decision
trace.action: Reconcile the evidence into ship, revise, or stop—without hiding dissent or uncertainty.

trace.title: Prepare the reversible execution
trace.action: Produce the migration, verification, communication, and rollback sequence approved by the owner.

trace.title: Enforce the release gate
trace.action: Release only when acceptance checks pass and the named human approval is present.

trace.title: Seal the decision record
trace.action: Record the evidence, approval, expected outcome, and rollback trigger for later audit.
